sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0009_azrila_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0009_azrila_* (game 1.6), as compiled by efsim kit-draft (frames, factors, elements, poise, SP, energy, Knock Downs, the combo's heal, team energy at 38, the guard's poise-only landing), plus what it leaves out: the guard's condition, talent 1's Protection, talent 2's ATK, the ultimate's team shield and P5's ATK. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0009_azrila.md, § Kit plan and § Kit (2026-10-21). Talent order (0-based): 0 = Inflamed for the Assault (Protection), 1 = Pay the Ferric Price (ATK when hit).

Not modelled: damage taken, shield points and heal amounts (Protection, the ultimate's shield and the combo's heal are buffs and heal events, for categories, operatorBuff predicates and heal triggers); the enemy being interrupted (InterruptAction immobilizedTime 1 in the combo and ultimate: batch-3 E1); super armour (SetSuperArmor 25 [0–55], talent 1's 35); hit-stops (Ti1b); P3's second heal ("another teammate with the lowest percentage HP", group CureTarget: HP isn't tracked, report U1); the dash attack (chr_0009_azrila_dash_attack, SkillPatchTable only: batch-3 S5). Unused files (no CharGrowthTable, SkillPatchTable or PotentialTalentEffectTable entry names them, and no used file reaches them): chr_0009_azrila_talent_0, _potential_5, _combo_skill_defend, _extra_attack, _tactic_skill, _dodge and the buffs only they reach.
The dive attack (plunging_attack_end) is written from the data like any skill; rotations can't schedule a dive until batch-1 S10 lands.

buffs.label: Inflamed for the Assault (talent 1): Protection while casting
buffs.note: Battle skill clip [0–38], combo clip [0–26]: if talent1 > 0, CreateBuff buff_chr_0009_azrila_normal_skill_shelter (ShelterAction rate = shelterrate, duration −1, autoFinishByAction: it ends with its clip); P1 first adds extrashelter (ModifyDynamicBlackboard operation 1, if potential_1 > 0). shelterrate, extrashelter and talent1 / potential_1 are SkillData keys talent 1 and P1 set on both skills (PotentialTalentEffectTable skillBbModifier), 0 otherwise. Ended at the clip's end by the triggers protection_end_battle / protection_end_combo. Damage taken isn't simulated: it's a Protection-category buff (attribute 63) for buffApplied triggers and operatorBuff predicates (Eternal Xiranite, Former Finery).

buffs.label: Nomadic Fort (P1): Protection after a hit
buffs.note: Battle skill frame 38 / combo frame 26: if potential_1 > 0, a target was hit (CheckEntityNum ≥ 1) and talent1 > 0, a second shelter buff with duration extratime (1.5 s at P1). The game buff has finishWithNextSkillIfNotInherited: it may end at Ember's next skill (not modelled; no damage effect).

buffs.label: Forward March: listening for an enemy hit [0–38]
buffs.note: chr_0009_azrila_normal_skill clip [0–38]: EventListenerAction (abilityEvent 101, CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 3 mask 805306368: Ember takes an enemy hit). Ended at frame 38 by trigger guard_listen_end. No game buff (it's the skill's own listener).

buffs.label: Forward March: hit while casting
buffs.note: buff_chr_0009_azrila_normal_skill_gpsuccess (BuffData blackboard dur 2 s, the literal duration here; stackingType 7). abilityEvent 31 with CheckSkillId normal_skill finishes it (written as endsWithCast). The slam's poise-only landing slam_guard deals extrapoise while it's on.

buffs.label: Pay the Ferric Price (talent 2): ATK up when hit
buffs.note: buff_chr_0009_azrila_talent_2 (attached by talent 2): abilityEvent 12 (Ember takes damage) with CheckObjectTypeMatch 16 and the enemy-attack mask 805306368 → buff_chr_0009_azrila_talent_2_buff (attribute 2 ATK formulaItem 6 + attack: 0.06 / 0.09; duration 7 s; stackingType 10, maxStackCnt 3, the literal cap here). stackingType 10: the loader runs its layers on one timer each new layer refreshes (batch-4 B3; in-game test 62's Ember variant settles it).

buffs.label: Re-Ignited Oath: Shield (team)
buffs.note: Ultimate frame 50: CreateBuff buff_chr_0009_azrila_ultimateshield on group Teammate (CharacterTeamFinder), duration 10 s, shield = hp_percent × Ember's Max HP (× extrashield 1.2 at P5). Its applyTags −1757502026 make it a shield (the loader adds the category) for operatorBuff predicates. Shield points and breaking aren't modelled: it lasts its full duration (report U2).

buffs.label: The Steel Oath (P5): ATK while shielded
buffs.note: ultimateshield's start event: if potential_5 > 0, CreateBuff (asChildBuff, targetSource 0: the shield's holder) buff_chr_0009_azrila_ultimate_skill_shield_extraattack (attribute 2 formulaItem 6 + extraattack 0.1); a child buff ends with its shield, so it has the shield's duration here (shields don't break: report U2).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable chr_0009_azrila_ComboSkill: "COMBO TRIGGER: When the controlled operator is attacked." (game code; no trigger action in the data). A perfectly dodged attack is no attack here (in-game test 53, Ember's variant).
Talent 2: "When Ember receives DMG from the enemy, she gains ATK +{attack} for {duration}s. This effect can reach 3 stacks."
Frame 0: talent 1's shelter (clip [0–38]) and the guard listener (EventListenerAction [0–38]).
The listener's and the shelter's clips end at frame 38 (autoFinishByAction); the slam's guard landing at 38 is judged before (its hit lands first).

"If Ember takes DMG from enemies during casting, the slam deals more Stagger when it hits." The listener → buff_chr_0009_azrila_normal_skill_gpsuccess. With dodging on she doesn't dash in frames [0, 38) of the battle skill (KitSkill.noDodge).
Combo clip [0–26]: talent 1's shelter, as for the battle skill.
The combo's shelter clip ends at frame 26 (autoFinishByAction).

hits.note: ChannelingAction [13–18], at most one tick per target: DamageAction damageType 0 (Physical; the operator is Heat), mask 128.
ChannelingAction [26–29]: mask 2097280 (Final Strike); poise 25 for the controlled operator (onlyEnableForMainChar); DoOnce ObtainCostAction atb (28) when controlled.
BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 0.9; finisher SP from the enemy (GainBreakingAttackAtb, the engine's).
Mask 1152 (basic + dive); ObtainCostAction atb (0 at every level) when controlled.

skills.label: Battle skill (Forward March)

hits.label: Leap
hits.note: ChannelingAction [10–15]: DamageAction atk_scale (Heat, damageType 2, mask 4352), no Stagger; HitStopAction 0.16 s.

hits.label: Slam
hits.note: Clip [38–41]: P1's shelter (CompareFloat potential_1, CheckEntityNum, CompareFloat talent1), KnockDownAction 1.5 s, DamageAction atk_scale2 (Heat) with a poise-only unit poise (10); team energy (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp if a target was hit); HitStopAction 0.2 s.

hits.label: Slam: guard Stagger
hits.note: Clip [38–41], after the slam's DamageAction: IfElse CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced (buff_chr_0009_azrila_normal_skill_gpsuccess ≥ 1) → a DamageAction whose only unit is poise extrapoise (10): Stagger only.

skills.note: Talent 1's Protection and the guard listener: triggers battle_cast, guard, guard_listen_end. The listener [0–38] wants Ember to be hit, so with dodging on she doesn't dash then (noDodge, batch-4 S12). Super armour 25 [0–55].

skills.label: Combo skill (Frontline Support)

hits.note: Clip [26–27]: InterruptAction (E1), P1's shelter, KnockDownAction 1.5 s, DamageAction atk_scale (Physical, mask 12288) with poise, HealAction on the controlled operator (CharacterTeamFinder + MainCharacterValidator; heal_base + Will × will_additive, healTags −1517158118: the combo heal, so the heal event's kind is combo), ObtainCostAction usp if a target was hit. P3's second heal (× extracure, group CureTarget) isn't an event (report U1).

skills.note: Its window opens when the controlled operator is attacked (trigger combo_window). TimeDilationAction [0–12] (the loader). Cooldown from SkillPatchTable (18 s at level 12).

hits.note: Frame 50: InterruptAction (E1), DamageAction atk_scale (Heat, mask 4608) with a poise-only unit poise (25), the team shield and P5's ATK on each holder. Damage immunity [0–90] (buff_common_damage_immune_ult_skill) is defensive. P4's energy cost × 0.85 is the loader's (skill parameters).
